settings.subtitle: DESIGNED IN VIETNAM · RELEASED IN LIMITED EDITIONS
settings.paragraph_1: PHAM (Profound Human Authentic Mastery) is an independent fashion label founded in Vietnam in 2026. We focus on dark, understated garments with considered volume, deliberate proportions and purposeful details. Our starting point is the shape and construction of each object—not a seasonal trend or oversized branding.
settings.paragraph_2: Rather than following a traditional seasonal calendar, PHAM develops one release at a time. The process moves from design and material research to physical samples, fit reviews and refinements. Each edition has a defined scope, and product information is documented so customers can understand what they are choosing.
settings.founder_body: PHAM was started by Coffee Pham in 2026, when he was sixteen and still in high school. He began without external funding, a team or established contacts in fashion. There was no existing collection or ready-made business behind the name—only an idea and the decision to learn how to make it real.
settings.edition_body: PHAM-001 is a cropped bomber jacket with relaxed sleeves, contrasting panels, shoulder mesh, metal zippers and adjustable side straps. Its proportions and detailing are being refined through sampling; the lookbook reflects a development sample, not a guarantee that every production detail is final.
settings.edition_note_value: 50 PLANNED OBJECTS · INDIVIDUALLY IDENTIFIED · NO RESTOCK
settings.founder_body_2: The first months meant researching garment construction, developing the PHAM-001 bomber, speaking directly with manufacturing partners, comparing fabrics and hardware, reviewing a physical sample, and building the storefront and release system. These were practical steps, often taken without prior experience or someone to delegate them to.
settings.founder_body_3: The work remains in progress. Samples reveal details to improve, and production decisions require care. PHAM does not ask to be judged by the founder's age or by an origin story. It aims to earn trust through clear information, considered design and the quality of each finished object.
settings.edition_body_2: Edition 01 is planned for 50 individually identified jackets, with no restock of the same edition after it closes. The planned package includes an edition identity card and a commemorative pendant. The pendant finishes are allocated as 49 silver-finished and one gold-finished piece; these descriptions refer to surface finishes, not solid precious metal.
settings.edition_body_3: Before ordering, use the product page to check the current specification and availability, the Size Guide to compare measurements, and Edition Details to understand the release structure. These pages should take precedence over earlier campaign visuals if a product detail changes during development.

settings.title: ONE OBJECT AT A TIME
settings.body: We focus development on a defined release rather than producing constant seasonal drops.

settings.title: DETAIL WITH A PURPOSE
settings.body: Cut, panels, mesh and hardware are considered together so each element serves the silhouette.

settings.title: SAMPLED AND REVIEWED
settings.body: Physical samples are examined for proportions, construction and finishing before production decisions.

settings.title: A CLEAR EDITION RECORD
settings.body: The first planned run is 50 individually identified jackets, with release information documented for buyers.
